sentences.en: The directors were reluctant to undertake so risky a venture.
sentences.zh: 董事们不愿意承担这么冒险的一项事业。

sentences.en: Would you like to take part in this risky experiment?
sentences.zh: 你想参加这个危险的实验吗？

sentences.en: It would probably be risky to do that by yourself.
sentences.zh: 你自己做这件事可能很冒险。

senses.zh: 冒险的，危险的,大胆的,<口>近乎猥亵的
